title: HAL: Hardware Abstraction Layer
description: Complete the LICHEN Hardware Abstraction Layer for all reference boards. This epic covers the common HAL API, per-board capability validation, and cross-board integration testing. The HAL provides a consistent interface for radio, BLE, GNSS, battery, buttons/LEDs, storage, and identity across Zephyr C and Rust implementations. Parent beads: ev5b.3 (R1 HAL boundary), h7t5 (Zephyr HAL foundation).
